answer: A sybil must acquire and hold separate timber stakes per reputation slot, and each stake is slashable if the agent's attestations diverge. Agents must stake a scarce, non-transferable resource: verified timber harvested from their own registered oasis plots, tracked on-chain. New participants can wander freely but earn no voting weight until their oasis yields audited timber across several epochs, making mass fake identities economically ruinous. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
